name: LazyGetterSingleton
description: Export a function that returns the singleton instead of exporting the instance directly. Prevents module-level initialization race conditions.
when_to_use: When a singleton depends on async initialization that may not have completed when other modules import it

name: FireAndForgetContract
description: When using async init with .catch() (fire-and-forget), document the consumer fallback contract as a 3-line comment cross-referencing where fallback defaults are applied.
when_to_use: When an async initialization is non-blocking and consumers must handle the uninitialized case

name: MergeDefaultsUtility
description: Use mergeDefaults(input, defaults) instead of repeated if-undefined guards. Spread order: defaults first, input second, so input values always win.
when_to_use: When applying 3+ default values to an input object

name: ChmodErrorPathTesting
description: Use fs.chmod to simulate read/write failures in tests instead of vi.spyOn on fs methods. ESM module isolation means spyOn on the test's fs import won't intercept the handler's fs import.
when_to_use: When testing error paths that involve filesystem read/write failures
